'''Rhandite Lorekeeper''' was the position held by [[Blessed Toxmalb]], one of the oldest members of [[Sorcerers of Rhand]]. From [[Rhand]], he could control [[Rhandites|Rhandite]] [[Pawn]]s who dwelt, scattered across the [[Nihil Retreat]].<ref name="TUR">''[[The Unknown Regions]]''</ref>
